name: Omarchy Minimize
author: Oliver Southgate
description: Hide Hyprland windows safely, restore their original workspace, and configure shortcuts from an accessible Omarchy sidebar.

barWidget.description: Shows and restores windows hidden on compatible special workspaces.

schema.label: Sidebar width
schema.description: Width in Omarchy spacing units; the panel remains clamped inside its screen.

schema.label: Transition timeout
schema.description: How long to wait for Hyprland to confirm an exact-address move before recovering safely.
